checks.statement: Use plain tooltips to briefly label an element or action, especially icon-only controls. Use rich tooltips for more details; they may include a title, links, or buttons.
checks.condition: When selecting a tooltip variant and content.

sourceHistory.summary: Overview defines plain/rich purposes and optional rich content.

evidence.result: Plain variant renders descriptive text beside an icon-only Details trigger; rich variant renders a heading, supporting paragraph and text action. Application content authors choose which information belongs in each variant.

checks.statement: M3 rich tooltips have more rounded corners than M2 and use updated color mappings compatible with dynamic color.
checks.condition: When applying M3 rich-tooltip styling or migrating from M2.

sourceHistory.summary: M2 comparison identifies rich-tooltip shape and color changes.

evidence.result: Container shape, background and text colors bind to plain/rich component tokens instead of fixed M2 values. The rich specimen resolves to 12px corners and rgb(242,236,244) in light/default.

checks.statement: Use a 24dp container height and 8dp padding.

sourceHistory.summary: Plain tooltip measurement table specifies height and padding.

evidence.result: The plain rule sets a 24px minimum height and 4px vertical/8px horizontal padding. Chromium measured a 24px height with those paddings. The captured requirement says 8dp padding without identifying its axes; confirming the diagram is needed before treating the vertical padding as a mismatch.

implementation.notes: The plain rule sets a 24px minimum height and 4px vertical/8px horizontal padding. Chromium measured a 24px height with those paddings. The captured requirement says 8dp padding without identifying its axes; confirming the diagram is needed before treating the vertical padding as a mismatch.

checks.statement: Use 12dp top padding, 8dp bottom padding, and 16dp left/right padding.

sourceHistory.summary: Rich tooltip measurement table specifies padding on each side.

evidence.result: The rich surface uses space150/space200/space100, resolving to 12px top,16px sides,8px bottom.
Chromium, light/default, rich variant. Enter on Show details opens the surface; getComputedStyle reports padding top 12px/right 16px/bottom 8px/left 16px.

checks.statement: A rich tooltip may contain a headline, body, and up to two buttons; the headline and button count are configurable.

sourceHistory.summary: Configuration section defines content parts and the maximum button count.

evidence.result: The rich renderer always emits Details and exactly one Got it button. The configuration matrix exposes variant/state, with no headline visibility or zero/two-action configuration.

checks.statement: Use a plain tooltip to briefly label an unlabeled element such as an icon-only button or field; avoid repeating an existing visible label. Use a rich tooltip to add context, definitions, explanations, or actions, but keep critical information out of tooltips because it is easy to miss; use an interruptive dialog for critical information.
checks.condition: When selecting tooltip type and content.

sourceHistory.summary: Usage guidance distinguishes label/help uses from detailed and critical information.

implementation.notes: Choosing context, omitting critical information and deciding whether a dialog is required are application content decisions. The isolated specimen supplies noncritical example text and no application decision flow.

checks.statement: Briefly describe the UI element; avoid wrapping across multiple lines or combining many pieces of information.

sourceHistory.summary: Supporting-text guidance sets concise, single-line content expectations.

implementation.notes: This is a content-authoring instruction. The specimen uses the short single-line More information text; the reusable stylesheet does not enforce semantic brevity or prohibit multiline caller content.

checks.statement: Keep an optional rich-tooltip subhead brief, ideally one line, and use it to summarize the message. Include a subhead when the rich tooltip appears automatically, such as on page load.
checks.condition: When adding a subhead to a rich tooltip.

sourceHistory.summary: Subhead guidance defines length, purpose, and automatic-display recommendation.

implementation.notes: Subhead wording and whether a product explanation appears automatically are authoring decisions. The specimen has a brief Details heading and only opens interactively; there is no page-load tooltip flow to assess.

checks.statement: A rich tooltip may have up to two text buttons; keep them short and relevant to the supporting text, and avoid stacking them when possible.
checks.condition: When a rich tooltip includes actions.

sourceHistory.summary: Button guidance sets count, relevance, brevity, and layout.

evidence.result: The rendered rich example contains one short Got it text button relevant to dismissing its explanatory text. It does not stack actions. Configuring a second action is assessed separately under rich-tooltip-configurations.

checks.statement: Place a plain tooltip above its parent by default, 4dp away when the parent has a visible boundary and 8dp away when it has none. In an app bar, place it below the element at the same distance.

sourceHistory.summary: Plain placement guidance specifies default side and boundary-dependent distance, including app-bar exception.

evidence.result: The plain tooltip is absolutely positioned at top:100% and horizontally centered, with no parent gap or app-bar placement distinction. This places it directly below the parent.
Chromium, light/default, plain variant. Measured parent bottom 380px and tooltip top 380px: gap 0px below parent. Focus on Details reveals the tooltip. Expected above with 4px boundary gap.

checks.statement: Place rich tooltips at the parent's bottom-right by default and adjust their position in 8dp increments to stay onscreen. Do not cover the parent. On desktop they may be centered below the parent and remain visible while the pointer moves within the target region.

sourceHistory.summary: Rich placement guidance specifies default and adaptive positioning and desktop behavior.

evidence.result: The anchor path positions below the trigger left edge with an 8px gap. It has no onscreen fallback/8px adjustment rule. The non-anchor JS path clamps/flips using raw viewport coordinates rather than 8px increments. Default bottom-right placement and guaranteed avoidance of parent overlap are not established.

checks.statement: On desktop, hover the parent to show a tooltip; on mobile, tap and hold. Persistent rich tooltips require a click or tap. Both variants disappear 1.5 seconds after leaving the target region, and opening a new tooltip closes any other one.
checks.condition: When showing transient tooltips or opening a new tooltip.

sourceHistory.summary: Transient guidance specifies input triggers, dismissal delay, and one-at-a-time display.

evidence.result: Plain disclosure follows hover/focus-within directly. The behavior module contains no pointer-hold recognition or1.5second exit timer, and plain CSS tooltips have no shared close-previous coordination. Rich is implemented only as a click-activated persistent popover.

checks.statement: Show persistent rich tooltips after a parent click or on page load to explain a new feature; keep them visible after the pointer leaves and dismiss only when another UI element is used. Do not trigger them on hover and avoid using them on icon buttons.
checks.condition: When using a persistent rich tooltip.

sourceHistory.summary: Persistent guidance specifies triggers, dismissal, hover behavior, and icon-button caution.

evidence.result: Rich uses native popover=auto on a labeled Show details button. Activation toggles it; no hover handler opens/closes it. Light dismissal and Got it close it, while pointer leave has no dismissal handler. No automatic page-load example is requested.

checks.statement: Assistive-technology users must be able to receive tooltip messages and activate tooltips with keyboard or switch input.

sourceHistory.summary: Use cases list message and activation tasks.

evidence.result: Plain trigger has aria-describedby pointing to role=tooltip. Rich has a labeled nonmodal dialog and native trigger/action buttons; keyboard activation was exercised. Actual screen-reader and switch-control delivery were not tested.

implementation.notes: Plain trigger has aria-describedby pointing to role=tooltip. Rich has a labeled nonmodal dialog and native trigger/action buttons; keyboard activation was exercised. Actual screen-reader and switch-control delivery were not tested.

checks.statement: Keep plain and rich tooltips without required actions visible long enough to read without disrupting the existing task. Tooltips may appear on hover or focus but must not hide crucial information; rich tooltips may also appear when an element is selected.
checks.condition: When showing tooltips to assistive-technology users.

sourceHistory.summary: Interaction guidance covers reading time, nondisruption, hover/focus and selected triggers, and critical information.

evidence.result: Plain remains visible while focus is in its demo and while hovered, with no read timeout. Rich remains a nonmodal popover until dismissed. Native popover does not make the page inert; the specimen text is supplemental. The separate transient-delay requirement remains missing.

checks.statement: Within a rich tooltip, move focus from top to bottom between interactive elements. Do not trap keyboard or screen-reader focus; allow users to continue linearly through the page.
checks.condition: When a rich tooltip contains interactive elements.

sourceHistory.summary: Focus-order guidance specifies sequence and prohibits focus trapping.

evidence.result: The rich popover contains one native action in DOM order and no key handler trapping Tab. Chromium Tab moved Show details to Got it then to the next Token set control. No screen-reader navigation run was performed.

checks.statement: Tab focuses an available button; Space or Enter activates the focused element.

sourceHistory.summary: Keyboard table maps focus and activation keys.

evidence.result: Trigger/action are native buttons. Tab enters the action; native Space/Enter activation opens or dismisses the popover.

Chromium, rich variant. Enter on Show details opens; Tab focuses Got it; Tab again reaches Token set:Plain. Space on Got it closes; Space on Show details reopens; Enter on Got it closes. Focus returns to Show details.

checks.statement: Expose the tooltip container with the Tooltip role or equivalent and label each child according to its own accessibility guidance.
checks.condition: When exposing tooltip content to assistive technology.

sourceHistory.summary: Labeling guidance specifies tooltip role and child-component labeling.

evidence.result: Plain has role=tooltip and its trigger references the tooltip ID with aria-describedby. Interactive rich content uses a labeled role=dialog rather than placing a button inside a tooltip role. Its Got it child is a native labeled button; static comparison samples are presentation-only sections.
